verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a German legal-document and company-formation service, so running hiring and equity paperwork is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only covers notarization, translation, apostilles, incorporation, and tax and trade registration. Nothing documents offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, or option grants. Generic document notarization with signer management is an adjacent capability, not this workflow.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform
